observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same scene from slightly different angles.
The set includes one 2-seater sofa with ornate gold-colored frame and tufted red upholstery.
Two matching 2-single armchairs with red tufted upholstery and gold-colored frame.

The armchairs have a classic design with rolled arms and a tufted seat.

claims.claim: A Royal unique 2 seater and complementary 2 singles sofas.
claims.evidence: The term 'Royal' is not visible on any part of the furniture. The design is ornate and luxurious, but no brand or model is readable. The term 'unique' is subjective and not verifiable from the photos.
The upholstery appears clean and well-maintained, but there are no visible signs of wear, stains, or damage. However, close-up shots of the fabric and frame are needed to confirm condition.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

Close-up of the gold frame material and finish.
Photos showing all components, including legs, internal mechanisms, and any included accessories.
Photos of the underside and back of the furniture to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
